posts.title: Former Cal and Michigan Guard Justin Pippen, Son of Scottie Pippen, Commits to Ohio State
posts.body:
Justin Pippen, son of NBA legend Scottie Pippen, has committed to Ohio State. The talented guard spent time at Cal and Michigan before making his decision to join the Buckeyes program.

A Legacy Name

Justin carries one of the most recognisable surnames in basketball history. His father Scottie won six NBA championships alongside Michael Jordan with the Chicago Bulls.

What This Means for Ohio State

The Buckeyes land a talented piece for their backcourt heading into next season. Justin brings athleticism and a high basketball IQ developed growing up around the game.

All eyes will be on Justin as he looks to forge his own path and live up to the famous Pippen name at the college level.
